Firebird+Forza XP

Posterior Lumbar Fusion · Orthofix Spine Reference

Two systems, one construct

Firebird NXG posterior pedicle screw fixation (T1–S2/ilium) paired with Forza XP expandable interbody spacers (L2–S1) — used together, Forza XP is never placed stand-alone.

Nominal 10mm width measures 10.5mm; nominal 24mm length measures 24.5mm. A 12mm-width variant of the Non-Lordotic 24mm family also exists (28-2240 / 2242 / 2244 / 2246). Expansion drive = total travel available at the driver. Graft volume ranges roughly 0.19–0.36cc unexpanded to 0.56–1.46cc expanded across the size range (available on request per size).

Distractor Sizing

Paddle distractors / rotating cutters, 6–16mm. Length marks 23 / 27 / 31mm on the instrument; a spacer is 1mm longer than the matching mark (23→24mm spacer, 27→28mm spacer). 31mm has no matching spacer size.

Navigated Pedicle Screw · O-arm/AIRO

1
Expose the posterior elements.
2
Attach the patient array to the spinous process.
3
AIRO spin and register the navigation image.
4
Navigated drill guide to the entry point — convergence of mid-transverse process / superior facet / pars. L1–S1: lateral pars & superior facet junction. S1: bicortical, angled medial & cephalad to the endplate.
5
Place a K-wire.
6
Navigated tap over the K-wire, one size under the screw (4.5 tap→5.5 screw, 5.5→6.5, 6.5→7.5). Cannulated taps required.
7
Hand screwdriver — screw fully threaded on the tip, coaxial with the shaft, no levering.
8
AIRO spin to check screw position.
9
Decorticate the head, seat the tulip, pull up to confirm capture.
10
Align saddles; reset height if the screw sits too deep.
11
Contour and place the rod.
12
Reduce (rocker or tubular reducer, 28mm max) — capture the rod, pins click into the body, hold the sleeve, turn the knob CW.
13
Provisional set screws — quarter-turn CCW first to avoid cross-threading.
14
Compress / distract with only that one set screw loose.
15
Final tighten to 80 in-lbs through the counter torque wrench, squarely seated.

Instrument Assembly Notes

Loading a tulip onto the inserter: align the tulip on the Multi-Axial Body Inserter before seating on the screw.

Multi-axial driver — 5 parts, two dots per part: sleeve → knob → shaft → flats → collar.
Modular driver — 4 parts, no dots: pinch buttons → knob → drive assembly. Unthreads if held distal-down.

Tubular reducer: soft-detent vs. tube-contact depths differ — confirm which stage you are in before applying force.

Decorticating planer (36-1334): rotate CW/CCW over the modular screw head to prep for full range of motion before seating the top loading body.

Cautions

!

Counter torque wrench not squarely seated → pedicle fracture or post-op loosening. Excess reduction force → screw pullout. Excess compression/distraction → pedicle fracture. Do not lever drivers. No repeated bending, notching, or scratching of implants. Single use, non-sterile. MR safety not evaluated.

Forza XP Implant Sequence

1
Discectomy (open or MIS), minimal root retraction. Ring curettes scrape linearly only — never rotate in the disc space. A collapsed disc space may need distraction first.
2
Distract sequentially with paddle distractors — sides against the endplates, then turn. Confirm size by number, not colour.
3
Prepare endplates with rotating cutters (blunt tip, cutting sides, two hands) and rasps.
4
Trial under A/P + lateral fluoro (trials 10mm wide, 24mm long, notch at 28mm). Slap hammer to withdraw.
5
Clamp the spacer to the inserter (knob CW, tug to check); insert fully collapsed under fluoro. Add the stabilizer for steering rigidity; slap hammer to pull back if needed.
6
Expand — driver into the expansion drive, seated to full depth, handle CW. Continuous & self-locking; CCW reverses. Must be expanded on insertion — never insert partly expanded.
7
Pack the graft window last, via funnel + plunger through the inserter cannula. Graft placed early blocks the driver; repositioning after may be impossible without collapsing first.
8
Graft contralaterally, release, withdraw the inserter.
9
Removal: locate on fluoro, reattach inserter, collapse, slap hammer off. Optional: Implant Remover 28-1003 + Driver 28-1004.

Cautions

!

Never insert a partly expanded spacer — expansion on insertion is mandatory. Do not place bone graft in the graft window prior to final positioning/expansion — it will block the driver. Always insert under fluoroscopic guidance. Prior to advancing any male thread, quarter-turn CCW first to avoid cross-threading.
